claim: Scores exact text, numeric tolerance, and checklist cards
sandbox: fresh /demo data; score all three sample cards; use 299802 at the inclusive 299792 ± 10 boundary and assert its answer-key row is matched, not missing

claim: Records the typed answer and explains the next interval
sandbox: fresh /demo; score one card and inspect stored evidence shown on the result
fresh /demo; download review CSV and assert headers plus one row per sample review
fresh /demo; download Anki CSV and assert the six fields plus three card rows

claim: Encrypted backups hide card text, restore valid records, and keep the current collection when decrypted data is malformed
where: Cards data tools, backup error status, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; export with a passphrase, inspect the envelope, remove a card, restore it, then try a correctly encrypted malformed payload and verify the prior collection remains

claim: Demo cards never enter the real collection
sandbox: fresh browser; open /demo, then choose Start for real and assert an empty real collection

claim: Try it with sample data opens three due sample cards in isolated browser storage
sandbox: fresh browser; start at /, click the primary action, assert ?demo=1, the banner, three due cards, and an empty real collection after Start for real

claim: Reset demo restores the sample without changing real cards
sandbox: fresh browser; create one real card, change demo data, reset, then verify three sample cards, two reviews, and the real card

claim: Study data and backup passphrases stay in the browser; analytics do not run; fonts and scripts are self-hosted
where: landing facts, Cards backup help, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; intercept the full review and encrypted-export flow and assert every request is same-origin with no analytics endpoint

claim: Browser site-data controls remove cards, reviews, demo changes, licenses, and cached app files

claim: Removing a card keeps it removed after reload and keeps its past review rows in Review CSV exports
where: Cards removal confirmation and status, privacy
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; add and review a card, remove it, reload, assert it remains absent, then export review CSV and assert its prior row remains

claim: A review can be completed with the keyboard at 390 px
sandbox: fresh mobile-sized /demo; fill controls and score with Ctrl+Enter

claim: Exact answers ignore case, accent form, and extra spaces
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; score the exact sample with uppercase decomposed accents and repeated spaces
fresh real collection; assert rapid double submission creates one card, then race two tabs from 29 cards and assert storage stops at 30

claim: A $19 one-time Recall Anchor Desk license adds unlimited cards and review trends
where: landing price, Cards page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh 30-card collection; assert the live Sociobot catalog price, checkout redirect, hosted one-time copy, and narrow Terms wording; mock a valid license response, restore the license, and assert the form and trends appear

claim: Sociobot is contacted only when you verify a license, receive one after checkout, or refresh a saved license after a day
sandbox: fresh contexts; record requests with no license, explicit verification, returned license, and a stale saved license

claim: An inactive saved license returns paid features to the free plan
sandbox: fresh 30-card collection; seed a cached valid license, return a revoked verification result, and assert the paid form is locked while exports remain available
